title: The Bully Who Insulted Mom's Biryani

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every school has that one bully. Ours was Bruno.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Ew. What is that smell? Is that YOUR lunch, Nix?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bruno mocked Mom's kacchi biryani. Every single day.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It's my mom's kacchi. She wakes up at five to make it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But Bruno made one mistake. He said it in front of Principal Huda.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Because Principal Huda's mother makes the exact same kacchi.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Nix, open your lunch box. Bruno, you will eat every single grain.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: It's the best thing I have ever eaten. I'm sorry, Nix.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Worth it. Follow for part two, Bruno joins family dinner.
